name: readvideo-desktop
description: Electron shell for AI Learner: serves the built renderer and runs the backend in the main process.

scripts.//dev: Loads the Next dev server for HMR — run `npm run dev` in front-end first.
scripts.//typecheck: esbuild only strips types, so this is the real check.

//package: Builds the .app/.dmg. Renderer and backend must be built first — use the root `npm run package`.
author: Mau Ulisse Luz
//electron: Pinned, not ranged: electron-builder needs an exact version to fetch matching binaries, and runtime upgrades should be deliberate.
//back-end: devDependency on purpose: esbuild inlines it, so nothing needs it at runtime.
//name: Drives app.getName(), and so the userData path — keep it aligned with productName in electron-builder.yml.
